citations.claim: Total energy at first violating step exceeds initial energy plus tolerance
Body speed increased from 60 to ~69 across wall impact, showing energy injection

explanation: Fast circle (60 m/s) hits thin 0.1-wide full-height wall at max dt=1/30. Step 3 shows body just before wall at x~8.0 speed ~60; step 4 after impact shows vx=-69 speed ~69 and energy ~2439J vs initial ~1858J. Positional correction plus impulse on deep penetration during substepped collision injects energy instead of conserving/dissipating it, violating energy_bound.
vision_note: The blue circle advances rightward toward the thin full-height vertical wall across steps 1 to 3. In step 4 it arrives at the wall's left face and remains in contact without visibly passing through, consistent with an impact at the violation step.
